notes.title: The Anniversary Update
notes.content:
We are proud to announce that Project Chemistry is getting out of Early Access with this update! We’ve added a ton of new features and refined the existing mechanics. With your help, we’ve localized the game so that more people can access it. We’ve added 92 new molecules, 517 new reactions and 42 new quests through Early Access. Quest Mode is now fully completable, you can unlock every element & molecule. Other than the in-game changes, Project Chemistry now has Steam trading cards.

[b][i]As the early access period has ended, Project Chemistry will receive a price increase from $10 to $15 on June 29th.[/i][/b]

[h1]Reaction Page:[/h1]
We've seen the previous reaction page creating a lot of confusion, especially when a reaction has more than one "type" like the CO2 combustion reaction that is also a synthesis reaction. With the new and improved reactions page, these "types" are tags that are on the reaction button.

[h1]Periodic Table:[/h1]
Well, the previous Periodic Table worked but we thought it could be better. We redesigned it to be more modern and improved the coloring options. They now use gradients instead of a few colors to better illustrate the change of a value. We also added new coloring options for Atomic Radius, Atomic Mass, Phase and a lot more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37304935/c55f96c1556bc0cc7a3c9f9aaed8fa3539873216.gif[/img]

[h1]Localizations:[/h1]
You guys are amazing, at first we were not sure if we should try community localization as we thought there may not be enough interest but holy s*ht. You guys localized over 900 keys to 4 different languages and even fixed mistakes in the English version. Thank you guys very much.

[h1]Improvements:[/h1]
-Upgraded the engine to Unity 2020.
-Redesigned the Reaction Page.
-Reaction buttons now mark the reactions that haven’t been conducted in quest mode.
-Redesigned the Periodic Table.

[h1]New Features:[/h1]
-Added new language options.
-New achievements for completing certain quests and much more.
-Added a credits page to the main menu (for everyone who contributed to the localization)
-Added 26 new molecules.
-Added 276 new reactions.
-Added 8 new quests.

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
-Fixed a bug where molecular elements’ molecule types would be displayed as N/A.
-Fixed a bunch of typos.

notes.title: The Lewis Update
notes.content:
In this update we added lewis structure fields for over 150 molecules! And while at it, we made it so the crystal structure field gets hidden when there is no structure instead of displaying a big ugly text saying “There is no crystal structure”. And of course there is no update without new molecules, so we also added a lot of new molecules ranging from Dopamine to Vitamin A.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37304935/28636126775e2af45d61d2e6296fe207f35a503f.png[/img]

[h1]Improvements:[/h1]
-Crystal structure displayer now gets hidden if there is no structure to display.
-Added a button for moving placed elements/molecules.
-Got rid of the smart board option on the main menu as it was no longer supported.
-Added variations for the loading screen images.
-Added hyperlinks to quest “to do” texts that open tutorials for the first few quests.
-Molecules button’s icon is now actually a molecule(don’t ask why it wasn’t).

[h1]New Features:[/h1]
-Added an option to the main menu for disabling molecule rotations.
-Added lewis structure section to molecule selection pop-up.
-Holding alt when placing an element/molecule will place it 3 times.
-Added 9 new molecules.
-Added 69 new reactions.
-Added 5 new quests.
-Added 2 new tutorials.

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
-Fixed Hydrogen’s color in the electronegativity periodic table.
-Fixed a bug where molecules would spawn inside each other.
-Fixed a bug where some reactions’ products were empty.
-Fixed a typo in KCl’s common name.

[url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1sdGcDnXuTNPK9nRnakBe93we6h9oOzcMNdvZd0EsjEw/edit#]Here [/url]is the full log of patch notes

notes.title: The August Update
notes.content:
In this update, we introduced a reward-checking mechanic to the quest mode. As we frequently update quests, we may also change the rewards they yield in the future. To make sure no one gets stuck because they completed a quest before its rewards were changed we added a refresh button to the quest page. It will work every time you enter the quest mode, however, in case a glitch occurs, you can always click the brand new refresh button we have added to the top left corner of the quest page.

[h1]Improvements:[/h1]
-Optimized the quest detection progress and some other stuff.

[h1]New Features:[/h1]
-Added a refresh button to the quest page for manually checking quest rewards.
-Added a custom cursor.
-Added 15 new molecules.

-Added 59 new reactions.

notes.title: Day One Patch
notes.content:
This update contains several bug fixes and improvements from the user feedback gathered from the Steam Summer game festival demo.

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
-Fixed a bug where the resolution &  the display mode would always go back to default.
-Changing resolution is now more consistent.
-Fixed tutorial 9 and 10.
-Changed the category radicals into ions.

[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
-Save system now uses caching which results in faster load times.
-Quest screen will no longer focus on the latest quest every time you open it.
-Notification will no longer cancel each other.
-Changed the label “Radicals” to “Ions” to be more scientifically accurate.
-Changing language should now happen a lot faster.

[url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1sdGcDnXuTNPK9nRnakBe93we6h9oOzcMNdvZd0EsjEw/edit#]Here [/url]is the full log of patch notes
